title: Death-Overs Risk: The Cost of One Missed Length for Rajasthan Royals
dek: A yorker that slips into a full toss is the costliest single mistake at the death. Ball-by-ball length labels put a price on it for Rajasthan Royals.
excerpt: Since 2022, each yorker that became a full toss has cost IPL bowlers {{ev:do-miss}} extra runs. Rajasthan Royals' death bowling has been more expensive than the league's since 2024.
author: CricField Editorial Desk

sections.heading: The Most Expensive Inch
body: Every death bowler aims at the same few centimetres at the base of the stumps. Hit them and the batter scrambles a single at best; miss by a hand's width and the yorker becomes a full toss.

Rajasthan Royals conceded {{ev:do-team-e1}} an over in the last five overs between 2008 and 2023, against {{ev:do-league-e1}} for the league, and {{ev:do-team-e2}} since 2024 against {{ev:do-league-e2}}.
On this measure their strongest season was 2011, at {{ev:do-x-best-v}}, and their weakest 2025, at {{ev:do-x-worst-v}}.

sections.heading: Pricing the Miss
body: Commentary labels allow each death delivery since 2022 to be priced. Across the rest of the league a yorker cost {{ev:do-ly}} runs per ball and a full toss {{ev:do-lf}}, so each miss costs {{ev:do-miss}} runs.
For RR the same miss has cost {{ev:do-tmiss}} runs per ball.

sections.heading: Who Bowls the Last Five
body: Since 2024 {{ev:dop-lead-name}} has bowled the most death-overs balls for RR, {{ev:dop-lead-balls}} of them, at an economy of {{ev:dop-lead-econ}}.
A death bowler's value is how rarely his misses become full tosses. Across a four-over spell, one miss an over adds {{ev:do-spell}} runs, roughly the margin of a tight finish.

sections.heading: What Commentary Labels Miss
body: Length labels come from text commentary rather than ball-tracking, and expensive deliveries may be described by their result. That would inflate the measured cost of a full toss.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Budget for the Miss, Then Shrink It
body: Rajasthan Royals' death bowling has been more expensive than the league's since 2024. The measurable skill to recruit for is a low full-toss rate under pressure, not a high yorker attempt rate.
Plans that mix hard lengths with the yorker cap the downside when execution slips.

methodology: Regulation innings only (super overs excluded). Economy uses runs charged to the bowler (byes and leg-byes excluded) per legal ball times six. Bowler wickets exclude run outs. Generated from the CricField warehouse by scripts/editorial/engine. Death overs = sixteen to twenty. Length labels from ball-by-ball commentary, 2022–2026; unlabelled balls excluded.
